beats.say: Your wall bugs fly up to 2 miles.
They sleep inside until a warm, sunny day.
Then they crawl toward your sunny windows.
They don't breed in your damn house. They nap in it.
They feed outside, on plants and seeds.
Come spring, they try to get the hell out. Many can't.
They all came in last fall. Because
